dataset.release: MP3D ObjectNav v1 val on mp3d-habitat

gpu_plan.note: launched without gpu_plan.py; devices as the command line and environment say

method.clock: global action ledger; room clock pauses off-floor

detector.model: habitat-sim semantic sensor (Matterport3D .house annotations, mpcat40 goal classes)

method.floor_exit_gate: none: a floor change is the building coordinator's to take at any time

glances.rule: at most one in-place glance per route, where along the route a left, right or full look reveals the most unknown floor the walk itself will not, if that clears the gain and gain-per-action floors; a suspended phase (no loop charge, clocks paused); a confident detection cut off by the frame's edge is a cue to turn toward it

ground_truth.context_labels: Matterport3D raw .house names, then mpcat40 classes, via ground_truth/mp3d_categories.py
ground_truth.goal_instances: the publisher's goal object ids per scene and category

kinematic.rule: every committed route is walked as the action sequence a Hybrid A* over (x, y, heading) finds with the benchmark's own step and turn as its only primitives, collision-checked on the clearance field at the route's standoff and priced in actions; the converter executes it verbatim while the agent stands where the plan expects it; a refused step is a pose the lattice may not step forward from, not a cell on the map

node_oracle.asks: independent P(target is in the part of the room not seen yet) per node, from the model's own knowledge of standard homes and buildings; the system prompt (the version named under 'prompt') states the task, what each field means, what the search so far means for a room (the more of it is mapped and searched, the less of it is left to hold the target; a room never entered has not been searched) and the reply format -- no room named for any object, no number or band, no list of goal categories, no worked example (2026-11-16; room_priors.py removed 2026-11-15); the user prompt gives the name of the episode's target, the HOUSE line (room types found, rooms unidentified, exits unlooked, the frontier state, actions used of the budget) and one line per room with four things (2026-11-17): its type (the objects seen only while it is unclassified), the floor mapped out of its free floor (m2 and share), the frontiers left, the actions spent inside ('never' for a room not entered); no distance, no neighbours and no word on where the robot stands -- travel is RPT*'s; the reply keeps home/house/stage and a first|second pass verdict before the numbers
node_oracle.cadence: loop points and semantic discovery -- a room on or off the offer, a room's type (discovery.semantic_signature, 2026-11-09); geometry alone within reconsider_min_actions of the last call waits for the loop point; unchanged prompts reused
node_oracle.nodes: every room of the floor in force (finished ones shown with their status); each room's exits are the room's attributes, not nodes
node_oracle.postprocessing: format: p or a drifted key, a number as text, a percent sign; ids nobody listed dropped; scale: percentages, also when written as fractions of one, clamped to 0-100, never renormalised; meaning: an omitted node 1%, a room never entered never 0 (read as 1%, then the loop's floor for unvisited rooms), an entered room's 0 stands and keeps it out of the order (min_prob); no knowledge of any room or object

method.openings: every exit of the storey (a doorway or gap at the edge of the mapped floor) is an attribute of the room it opens from, never a node with a number of its own (kept on the room's node for the record; not on its prompt line since 2026-11-17, where the frontier count stands for what is left); the room's own frontier walk looks through them, and a finished room with GAPs left to walk is offered again for them (room-level GAPs, 2026-10-21); a confirmed landmark of the target's class is a node at p=0.85 without an oracle call, visited by a peek from 1.5 m
method.reasoning_cadence: room LLM at loop points and semantic discovery events; geometry every 1 action(s), every 5 while a committed transit route is walked (rebuilt on the action the transit ends); synchronous frame processing, one full rotation (warm-up scan) before room selection on every storey first entered

room_extents.rule: observed map only: every room's boundary faces on the agent's own occupancy grid classified by what lies beyond them (wall, another room of its own partition, settled unknown, unseen unknown) and grouped into four sides by outward normal in the storey's wall frame; a side is seen when at most open_tolerance of its faces open onto unseen space in runs wider than doorway_max_m; with four seen sides no part of the room lies outside the map ('all sides mapped' -- not a final size: the partition may still join or re-cut rooms), else the size is a lower bound shown as 'at least'; coverage is the room's share of the observed cells; recomputed from the live map and partition on every update, keyed by cell, never by room id; shown to the node oracle as mapped= -- the observed part of the room's free floor out of that floor, in m2 and as a share: floor the robot cannot stand on (furniture, settled pockets) is not counted (2026-11-17); nothing but that map, its partition, the sight record and the pose enters the reading -- no simulator geometry, no room annotations, no size priors (core/mapping/topology/room_extent.py)

method.room_partition: watershed of observed free space with seen stair footprints excluded; stairs are never a room; a detected door's cut is snapped to the nearest choke within 0.9 m; furniture is credited to the nearest room floor; room numbers are unique across the building
method.room_visit: frontier walk: the room's frontier that reveals the most unknown floor per metre walked, then the next, until none is left (bounded by 60 actions); a room the agent stood in with no live frontier is finished (explored), and so is a room a full rotation stood in or saw more than half of, one with no live frontier the camera looked into or walked through, or a doorless fragment under 3.0 m2; every rotation is as many turns as the camera's field of view needs to see the circle; every exit of the storey is an attribute of the room it opens from and is walked by that room's visit, and a finished room with GAPs left to walk is offered again for them (room-level GAPs); finished rooms are shown to the oracle with their status and offered again (DISABLED: second_pass off) once its pass verdict says the home is covered (a revisit scans from a spot at least 1.5 m from the earlier scan points); every unfinished room is valued by the oracle whatever its type (no type exclusion); a room's label is strong on two or more kinds of object and a confident model

segmentation.depth: robust_mask_depth over the mask within the box; near-surface component, no coherence gate
segmentation.scope: target boxes at or above detection_confidence

sight.rule: unknown looked through from 2 poses within 2.5 m without a depth return, and enclosed unknown pockets under 3.0 m2 that nothing could stand in (inscribed width under 0.6 m, or stood on by the agent), are settled: not frontier, not openings, not glance gain; the planner and the display keep the real map; every free cell seen within 4.0 m with a clear line of sight, at a pitch that puts an object body 0.3-1.0 m tall in the frame, is OBSERVED (per cell, per storey)

method.standing_points: observed map only: a standoff, a back-off spot or a nearest-floor goal is a cell observed free, with every cell within the body radius (0.18 m) of it observed free too, joined to the agent through such cells; it keeps 0.25 m from every observed obstacle, and 0.18 m when no route is found at that; unknown cells are never stood on, never counted as clearance and never planned through; no simulator geometry (world_model/standing_floor.py)
